name: The One: Vol. 2
source:
Stuck in a rut, you don’t hesitate when offered a chance to join the cast of your favorite dating show. 

But love is hard, and soon you’re entangled in drama – all for entertainment.

[From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_One]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
translation:
生活一成不变、陷入瓶颈的你，在受邀参加自己最喜爱的恋爱真人秀时毫不犹豫地一口答应。

然而寻爱之路绝非坦途，你很快便被卷入重重狗血风波之中——毕竟，一切都是为了节目效果。

[摘自[url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/The_One]romance-club.fandom[/url]]
